primary.name: moj-accuracy
primary.note: Accuracy mode. Two System-1 steps: step 1 commits at fitted confidence 0.95; abstained pairs pay the router (two System-1 reads). Long-form writing terrain: System-1 pairwise plus the computed length feature, weights fitted on abstained long-form practice pairs. Writing terrain: stay with System 1. Reasoning terrain: reference first, then under 0.8 the gpt-6-luna verdict joined with the Haiku verdict (second family). Elsewhere: the gpt-6-luna verdict. System-2-family calls stay at or under 2 per pair on every practice set.

secondary.name: moj-economy
secondary.note: Economy mode: r9-two-step as frozen and confirmed on the first sealed run (commit 9be7b751). Round 9. Two System-1 steps: step 1 answers (commit) or abstains; step 2, for abstained pairs only, reads the terrain and picks the design (stay with System 1 on writing, reference first on reasoning then the System-2 verdict if still under the stop, System-2 verdict elsewhere). Thresholds fitted on the tuning half: the cheapest setting whose cross-fitted tuning accuracy is within 0.5 point of the best (commit 0.8, reference stop 0.6).

weights_fitted_on: all practice pairs (850); the weights are refitted from the hashed practice signals at score time and must equal these

models.second_family_member_of_accuracy_mode: Claude Haiku through the claude CLI, low effort, on reasoning terrain under the stop only

cells.mmeval: CONFIRMATORY, the only cell in the test family: 600 never-scored ids, one per prompt group, disjoint from practice and from the first sealed run.
cells.judgebench: SECONDARY, outside the test family: 179 Claude-response pairs, unseen by MoJ, previously scored by the ledger harness, whose after-the-fact analysis informed the MoJ design. Cannot confirm anything alone.
cells.writing: SECONDARY, outside the test family: 217 pairs (44 never scored plus 173 unseen by MoJ, previously scored by the ledger harness, whose after-the-fact analysis informed the MoJ design). Cannot confirm anything alone.

endpoints.primary: MM-Eval: accuracy mode minus promptfoo select-best (gpt-6-luna medium, both orders), paired by pair, half credit for a split. One test, two-sided 0.05; a paired bootstrap (20,000 draws) gives the interval and the p-value.
secondary: MM-Eval: accuracy mode minus our ledger
MM-Eval: accuracy mode minus economy mode
JudgeBench and writing: the same three differences, with intervals, labelled secondary
Writing: accuracy mode against longer wins; the target is level with longer wins and well above promptfoo, no claim of beating the length rule
endpoints.reported_both: strict both-order rule and half credit, on every benchmark

rule_for_a_win: Accuracy mode wins the confirmatory cell when the lower bound of the 95 percent paired interval against promptfoo is above 0 and its System-2-family calls per pair are at or under 2.
network_rules: 10 healthy probes before the first sealed call; 2 calls in flight; a transport no-answer is recovered missing-only; a pair counts as a MoJ loss only after a final recovery cycle (gateway 403 by content: a loss).
budget: 25 USD of System-2 spend for this round; projected after the first 50 pairs of each benchmark.
